about_the_game:
Enter a classic Action-style Roguelike ARPG-MMORPG world and go through the 4 Acts of the world to reach Hell itself and defeat the 3 most threatening Demons in the Nothorian world.

The Lord of Chaos, imprisoned in hell since time immemorial, has returned to achieve his long-awaited dream, crossing the Portal of Destiny to access our world and sow Terror. Currently, the power of an Ancestral Goddess that only remains in the memory of those who knew of her existence, emerges agai

n and new Heroes mysteriously appear where they have everything necessary to try to find and defeat the Lord of Hell before he manages to reach us.

The Player will be able to manage and customize their characters in a solid ARPGMMORPG adventure with possible future expansions, with an original and epic soundtrack that will accompany players during the many hours that this title offers us, providing a dynamic and classic approach increasingly closer in search of new constructions for your characters.

By defeating the 3 Great Demons you will gain access to the Endgame Dungeons, each designed to offer a different environment and challenges to obtain new types of more powerful items.

Nothorian: The Eternal Conflict between Heaven and Hell

At the dawn of creation, when the cosmos was still a blank canvas, two opposing forces arose: the Gods, guardians of light and life, and the Lords of Hell, embodiments of darkness and destruction. For eons, these two factions waged an endless war, a cycle of epic battles that shook the foundations of reality.

The Gods, with their divine power and mastery of creation, often emerged victorious from these clashes. However, their nature was tied to the very fabric of the universe, and over time, this fabric began to weaken, taking the power of the Gods with it. Unlike them, the Lords of Hell possessed a sinister quality: the ability to rise from their ashes, again and again, after each defeat.

The Age of Divine Twilight

In the current era, the cosmic balance has tilted dangerously. The heavens, once bastions of divine power, have darkened, and the Gods, weakened by the passage of time and the wear and tear of countless battles, stand on the brink of extinction. The Lords of Hell, sensing the vulnerability of their eternal enemies, have seized this opportunity to unleash their fury upon the mortal world.

Hordes of demons and infernal creatures emerge from the depths, wreaking havoc and destruction in their wake. Mortal realms, once protected by divine vigilance, now find themselves at the mercy of dark forces.

The Awakening of Heroes

Faced with the imminent threat of annihilation, the Gods, in a final act of desperation, extend their waning power to mortals. They bestow divine blessings upon those who demonstrate courage and purity of heart, granting them the ability to stand against the Lords of Hell and their legions.

Bearers of hope in a world on the brink of the abyss, these blessed heroes stand as the last line of defense against the darkness. Their mission: to repel the infernal invasion, restore cosmic balance, and if possible, find a way to return the fallen gods to their power.

Begin your adventure with the Relentless Warrior, the Powerful Wizard, or the Versatile Nightshade.

  • Prioritizes the range of his Strength, Physical Defense and has more health, can unleash powerful melee attacks and some from a distance, is able to withstand large amounts of Aggression.

  • Prioritizes the range of his Intelligence, Magic Resistance and has more Mana, controls Fire, Ice, Lightning and Wind, thanks to the elements he can cause great damage from a distance and control the situation.

  • Prioritizes the range of his Versatility, Dexterity and has the resources to neutralize the enemy and come out unscathed with his Stealth, controls Bows better and chooses to use Daggers, can poison and cause great damage quickly.

  • Explore extensive zones in search of Story.

  • Gather your courage to face the difficult Raids.
